title: Fluff Gamemode Control
description: FluffGamemodeControl is a server-side Forge mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that allows players to switch between Survival, Creative, Adventure, and Spectator modes using commands, with LuckPerms permission support!
body:
## Fluff Gamemode Control

🎮 Gamemode Management for Forge 1.20.1

✨ **Fluff Gamemode Control** gives you full control over player gamemodes on your Forge server – **simple, fast, and secure!**

### **🌟 Features:**

* 🔄 **Switch gamemodes**: Survival, Creative, Adventure & Spectator
* ⚡ **Shortcuts for quick access:**

  * `/gms` → Survival 🛡️
  * `/gmc` → Creative 🏗️
  * `/gma` → Adventure 🏹
  * `/gmsp` → Spectator 👀
* 📝 Alternatively, you can also use:
  `/gm survival`, `/gm creative`, `/gm adventure`, `/gm spectator`

### **🔐 LuckPerms Integration:**

* Control who can use which gamemode:

  * `gm.survival` → Survival 🛡️
  * `gm.creative` → Creative 🏗️
  * `gm.adventure` → Adventure 🏹
  * `gm.spectator` → Spectator 👀
* ❌ Players without permission will see the message:

```
You do not have permission for this gamemode!
```

### **🛠️ Admin Examples:**

* Grant all gamemodes to the admin group:

```bash
/lp group <group> permission set gm.survival true
/lp group <group> permission set gm.creative true
/lp group <group> permission set gm.adventure true
/lp group <group> permission set gm.spectator true
```

### **💡 Advantages:**

* ✅ Completely server-side – **no client mod required**
* ✅ Fine-grained permissions through LuckPerms
* ✅ Fast & flexible for both players and admins
* ✅ Perfect for survival, minigame, or roleplay servers

🚀 **Get Fluff Gamemode Control and bring order to your server’s gamemodes!**


## Fluff Gamemode Control 
🎮 Gamemode Steuerung für Forge 1.20.1

✨ **Fluff Gamemode Control** bringt volle Kontrolle über Gamemodes auf deinen Forge-Server – **einfach, schnell und sicher!**

### **🌟 Features:**

* 🔄 **Gamemode wechseln**: Survival, Creative, Adventure & Spectator
* ⚡ **Shortcuts für schnelle Befehle:**

  * `/gms` → Survival 🛡️
  * `/gmc` → Creative 🏗️
  * `/gma` → Adventure 🏹
  * `/gmsp` → Spectator 👀
* 📝 Alternativ auch über `/gm survival`, `/gm creative`, `/gm adventure`, `/gm spectator`

### **🔐 LuckPerms-Integration:**

* Steuere, wer welche Gamemodes nutzen darf:

  * `gm.survival` → Survival 🛡️
  * `gm.creative` → Creative 🏗️
  * `gm.adventure` → Adventure 🏹
  * `gm.spectator` → Spectator 👀
* ❌ Spieler ohne Berechtigung sehen eine Nachricht:

```
§cDu hast keine Berechtigung für diesen Gamemode!
```

### **🛠️ Admin-Beispiele:**

* So erlaubst du allen Admins alle Gamemodes:

```bash
/lp group <group> permission set gm.survival true
/lp group <group> permission set gm.creative true
/lp group <group> permission set gm.adventure true
/lp group <group> permission set gm.spectator true
```

### **💡 Vorteile:**

* ✅ Komplett serverseitig – **kein Client-Mod nötig**
* ✅ Feingranulare Berechtigungen über LuckPerms
* ✅ Schnell & flexibel für Spieler und Admins
* ✅ Perfekt für Survival-, Minigame- oder Roleplay-Server

🚀 **Hol dir Fluff Gamemode Control und bring Ordnung in deine Gamemodes!**
